note: Field Image Style defines an image_style field type (Options ListItemBase; value = an image-style machine name; cardinality forced to 1; storage settings allowed_values + sort; widgets options_select/options_buttons; list formatters list_default/list_key) plus a display formatter image_style_image_formatter on core image fields whose field_image_style setting names an image_style field to read the style from. No configure route (configure=null), no permissions, no Drush, no plugin types. Medium cases read back real field-storage settings and a real display component; hard cases create the field and wire the formatter, verified against live field config and entity_view_display.

evals.prompt: In the Drupal contrib module field_image_style, what field type does it add, what does a stored value represent, and where do the selectable options come from?
evals.expected_output: It adds a field type with plugin id 'image_style' (class ImageStyleItem, extending the Options ListItemBase). Each value stores the machine name of an image style; the selectable options are the site's configured image styles (image_style_options()). Cardinality is forced to 1; default widget options_select, default formatter list_default.

evals.prompt: Using field_image_style, how do I make an image field render with an image style that the editor chose in another field on the same node? Name the formatter and the setting that points at the style field.
evals.expected_output: Put an image_style field on the bundle, then set the image field's formatter to image_style_image_formatter ('Field Image Style formatter'). Its field_image_style setting names the image_style field to read; at render time the formatter applies that stored style (falling back to the original image when empty).

evals.prompt: How do I limit which image styles an editor can choose in a field_image_style field, and what happens if I leave that restriction empty?
evals.expected_output: Set the field storage setting allowed_values (the 'Allowed image styles' checkboxes) to the subset of image-style machine names you want. Leaving it empty allows all configured image styles. The 'sort' storage setting sorts the options by label.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has an image_style field named field_fis_known whose allowed image styles have been restricted. Inspect the live field storage and list which image styles are selectable in that field.
evals.expected_output: The field storage field_fis_known has allowed_values restricted to the 'medium' and 'wide' image styles (with sort enabled), so only those two styles are selectable.

evals.prompt: On this site the Article default view display renders the image field field_fis_img with Field Image Style. Inspect the live display configuration and state which formatter it uses and which field supplies the image style.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_view_display.node.article.default the field_fis_img component uses the image_style_image_formatter formatter with settings.field_image_style = field_fis_disp, so the style comes from the field_fis_disp image_style field.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, add a Field Image Style field with machine name field_fis_task to the Article content type (entity type node), so editors can pick an image style per article. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Create a FieldStorageConfig for node named field_fis_task with type 'image_style' (cardinality 1), then a FieldConfig instance on the article bundle. The default widget is options_select.

evals.prompt: On this site the Article content type has an image field field_fis_wimg and a Field Image Style field field_fis_wsrc, but the image currently renders with the plain core image formatter. Reconfigure the default view display so field_fis_wimg is rendered by the Field Image Style formatter, taking its image style from field_fis_wsrc. Apply the change live.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_view_display.node.article.default set the field_fis_wimg component type to image_style_image_formatter with settings.field_image_style = field_fis_wsrc and save.
